'''Anton Saar''' was the author of the book, ''[[Of Droids and Men]]''. An excerpt from this book began the chapter on [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al's]] condensed version of ''[[Report on Growth, Organization, Equipment, Activities, and Objectives of the Rebellion]]''.<ref name="RASB">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>
